name: O’Reilly
description: Connect Claude to O’Reilly’s extensive catalog of high-quality technical and professional skills development resources. Just tell Claude what you’re looking for and you’ll get top recommendations for O’Reilly books, video courses, upcoming live events, curated learning plans, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add O’Reilly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add O’Reilly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.oreilly.com/api/content-discovery/v1/mcp/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the O’Reilly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: O’Reilly provides these MCP tools: search_oreilly_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to O’Reilly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to O’Reilly in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
O’Reilly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
O’Reilly is developed by O’Reilly Media. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
